shortBulletSummary: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has dropped to 39, reflecting a sentiment of fear in the market.
Bitcoin has seen a slight decline but is showing resilience above key support levels.
The US has sanctioned Iran-linked crypto wallets, leading to Tether freezing $344 million in USDT.
The European Union has enacted new sanctions banning Russian crypto platforms, increasing market volatility risks.
Ethereum ETFs continue to see strong weekly inflows, indicating robust institutional demand for ETH.
